headline: Broken ladders are half-real now
lede: DONKEY KONG's flickering bait ladders got the original's cruelest trick: they climb — part-way. Grab one, hang on the last rung over the gap, and decide fast.

notes.text: #3618 shipped as #3625: broken ladders keep their lower span (deterministic break lines, no new dice) — mount from the foot, hang at the break with a thud, climb back down. The WATCH seat still never trusts a broken rung, so all 24 replay seeds ride byte-identical.
The human tag on the shell's key input is the seam: rollout candidates arrive untagged and refuse half-rungs — widen that tag and the seat floors rebuild. Pinned in README + kongcheck.

Before building the barrels-mid-air gap, a Node trace proved it unreachable on the current layout (zero airborne ladder crossings in thousands of ticks) — the fix needs end-of-girder ladder geometry, split to #3622 and slot b is already inside it.
Fixed one stale watchcheck pin that sat red on main since #3598 (height-monotone gate matched the old progress() shape). Kong gates now: 117/0, 34/34 mutants, drive 14/14, watchcheck 318/318.

look.text: Climb the flickering ladder and feel it give out under you
